speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I am Dr. Agent, and I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress. To help me understand your condition, can you tell me how long you have been having trouble breathing and if you have been feeding well?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) due to prematurity.

As a 33-week preterm infant presenting with respiratory distress two hours after birth, your condition is highly suggestive of neonatal RDS. I will now request a Chest X-Ray to confirm the diagnosis and rule out other causes like transient tachypnea of the newborn or meconium aspiration.

REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray
